# HTML vs. HTML with CSS

#### Course: Learn CSS

## HTML vs. HTML with CSS

Consider a simple webpage that includes text, images, and layout elements. Without CSS, the webpage might look like this:

![A Webpage with Only HTML](data:image/png;base64,)

After applying CSS to the webpage, you can transform it to look like this:

![A Webpage with HTML and CSS](data:image/png;base64,)

As you can see, CSS enhances the webpage's appearance, making it more attractive and user-friendly.
